# autter_repositories (Data Source)

Every repository connected to the token's Autter organization (up to 500), ordered by full name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "autter_repositories" "all" {}

output "repository_names" {
  value = [for r in data.autter_repositories.all.repositories : r.full_name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `full_name` (String) `owner/repo`.
- `id` (String) The repository's id.
- `name` (String) The short name.
